import json
import re
import sys

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

item_id = sys.argv[1]
base = "/home/agus/workspace/asermax/nagara/.scratch/markdown-and-lists/reports/prod-data"

with open(f"{base}/{item_id}.html", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    html = f.read()

with open(f"{base}/{item_id}.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    item = json.load(f)

soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

for tag in soup(["script", "style", "noscript", "template"]):
    tag.decompose()

candidates = [
    soup.find("article"),
    soup.find(attrs={"itemprop": "articleBody"}),
    soup.find(id=re.compile("content|post|article", re.I)),
    soup.find(class_=re.compile("post-content|article-body|entry-content|available-content", re.I)),
    soup.find("main"),
]
body = next((c for c in candidates if c is not None), soup.body or soup)

counts = {
    "headings": len(body.find_all(re.compile(r"^h[1-6]$"))),
    "paragraphs": len(body.find_all("p")),
    "blockquotes": len(body.find_all("blockquote")),
    "lists": len(body.find_all(["ul", "ol"])),
    "list_items": len(body.find_all("li")),
    "code_blocks": len(body.find_all("pre")),
    "inline_code": len(body.find_all("code")),
    "tables": len(body.find_all("table")),
    "images": len(body.find_all("img")),
    "links": len(body.find_all("a", href=True)),
    "emphasis": len(body.find_all(["em", "i", "strong", "b"])),
}

print(f"=== {item_id} :: {item['url']} ===")
print(f"container matched: {body.name} {body.get('class') or body.get('id') or ''}")
print("HTML body element counts:", json.dumps(counts))

units = item["units"] or []
type_counts = {}
for u in units:
    type_counts[u["type"]] = type_counts.get(u["type"], 0) + 1
print("unit type counts:", json.dumps(type_counts))

md_signals = {
    "heading_markers (^#{1,6} )": 0,
    "blockquote_markers (^> )": 0,
    "bullet_markers (^[-*] )": 0,
    "numbered_markers (^\\d+\\. )": 0,
    "code_fence (```)": 0,
    "bold_markers (\\*\\*)": 0,
    "link_markdown (\\[.*\\]\\(.*\\))": 0,
    "table_pipe (^\\|)": 0,
}
for u in units:
    d = u.get("display", "")
    for line in d.splitlines():
        line_stripped = line.strip()
        if re.match(r"^#{1,6} ", line_stripped):
            md_signals["heading_markers (^#{1,6} )"] += 1
        if re.match(r"^> ", line_stripped):
            md_signals["blockquote_markers (^> )"] += 1
        if re.match(r"^[-*] ", line_stripped):
            md_signals["bullet_markers (^[-*] )"] += 1
        if re.match(r"^\d+\. ", line_stripped):
            md_signals["numbered_markers (^\\d+\\. )"] += 1
        if line_stripped.startswith("|"):
            md_signals["table_pipe (^\\|)"] += 1
    if "```" in d:
        md_signals["code_fence (```)"] += 1
    if "**" in d:
        md_signals["bold_markers (\\*\\*)"] += 1
    if re.search(r"\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)", d):
        md_signals["link_markdown (\\[.*\\]\\(.*\\))"] += 1

print("markdown signals across unit display fields:", json.dumps(md_signals))

spoken_leak = []
for i, u in enumerate(units):
    s = u.get("spoken", "")
    if re.search(r"[#*_`>\[\]]|^\s*-\s|^\d+\.\s", s):
        spoken_leak.append((i, u["type"], s[:120]))
print(f"spoken units with possible markdown-syntax leakage: {len(spoken_leak)}")
for i, t, s in spoken_leak[:5]:
    print(f"  unit {i} ({t}): {s!r}")

print()

Original HTML fetched with `curl` and parsed with BeautifulSoup/lxml against a best-guess `
`/`
` container; that container selection is a heuristic, so absolute counts (especially links) can include boilerplate (bylines, share links) the extraction correctly drops. Bold and one markdown link survive (`**...**`, `[text](url)`). **itm_46f35877 (cutlefish.substack.com)** — 4 lists (36 `
  • ` total) each collapse into **one** paragraph unit with `- ` bullets in `display`. `spoken` drops the bullets but also drops the separator between items, sometimes down to zero characters: `display`: `"- Signals: What is observed, recorded, written, or measured\n \n- Insights / Interpretation..."` `spoken`: `"Signals: What is observed, recorded, written, or measuredInsights / Interpretation..."` — `measured` runs directly into `Insights` with no space, a genuine word-boundary bug an ear catches immediately. The 3 HTML links this item scored are the substack byline/avatar, not article content, so 0 markdown links in the units is correct, not a loss. **itm_29512ea6 (newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com)** — largest sample (178 paragraph units from 167 HTML `

    `, because list items and the article's own numbered headings each got their own unit here rather than merging). All 11 headings, including author-numbered ones like `1. Latest models create "a-ha" moments`, land as bare paragraphs — `display: "1\\. Latest models create "a-ha" moments"` (the period is backslash-escaped so a markdown renderer won't read it as an ordered-list start) and `spoken: "1. Latest models create "a-ha" moments"` (correctly unescaped). None of the 14 blockquotes get a `>` prefix; they read as plain paragraphs distinguished only by the curly quotation marks the source itself used, e.g.: `spoken: "Any time I have to type precise syntax by hand now [instead of using AI] feels like such a tedious chore..."` Of the 7 lists, one (the numbered "1./2./3./4." section list) got split into per-item paragraph units (each list item became its own paragraph, quoted above); others merge the same way as itm_46f35877. Bold survives (`**`) at roughly half the HTML `` count (40 vs. 76 tags) — the gap is mostly nested/short em-dash emphasis inside already-bold runs, not dropped content. 3 of 4 images made it through; no degradation row for the 4th, worth a follow-up but not confirmed here. **itm_ecda776e (ngrislain.github.io)** — the cleanest code fidelity of the sample: all 12 `

    ` blocks became 12 separate `code` units 1:1, e.g. HTML
`inductive List (α : Type) where | nil : List α | cons : α → List α → List α` matches the
unit's `display` verbatim. All 12 headings (h1 title plus 11 h2/h3, e.g. `"Types as
specifications"`, `"A worked example: sorting with proof"`, `"Defining a list"`,
`"Expressing "sorted""`) are flattened to plain paragraphs with no markdown marker — in a
document whose whole argument is structured by those headings, the reading surface loses
all of that hierarchy. The one list (an `
      ` with 3 items) merges into one paragraph
unit, and — same defect class as itm_46f35877 — `spoken` concatenates the 3 items with no
separating space or pause:
`spoken: "...the specification, the contract, the "what."AI writes the implementation..."`
Escaped inline code (`` `int` ``, `` `sorry` ``) survives in `display` and is unescaped in
`spoken`.

**itm_407e8fa6 (harper.blog)** — 4 of 5 images survive; the 5th has a `degradations` row
(`reason: "too small (768x146)"`), a legitimate drop, not a defect. 3 lists (13 items)
follow the same merge-and-concatenate pattern as the two cases above. The one blockquote
and all 4 headings are plain paragraphs.

**itm_568773a3 (jamesshore.com)** — no lists in this article, so the list-merge defect
doesn't apply, but all 14 headings do flatten:
HTML `
      Does Maintainability Even Matter?
      ` and `
      One Ring to Rule Them All
      `
both appear verbatim as unit 3 and unit 9's `display`, with zero markdown distinguishing
them from unit 4 or unit 10's body text. 13 markdown links survive out of 20 HTML links
(the gap is mostly the "part 1"/"part 2" cross-post nav links and the RSS/subscribe CTA,
correctly treated as boilerplate).

**itm_5e723272 (scientificamerican.com)** — smallest structural sample (3 headings, no
lists, no blockquotes, one image dropped from 2 — likely a duplicate lead image/og:image,
not confirmed via degradations since none was recorded). No list or blockquote defect
surface to observe here; headings still flatten to plain paragraphs.

**itm_95ca2339 (blog.bustikiller.com)** — plain, single-column post; 4 headings flatten
to paragraphs, no lists or quotes present, nothing else notable.

## Summary: element-type survival across the 8 items

| Element | Present in HTML (approx.) | What happens in the persisted units |
|---|---|---|
| Headings (`h1`–`h4`) | 53 across the 8 items | **Never** distinguished: 0 of 53 kept any markdown marker (`#`) or bold. All become plain `paragraph` units, textually identical to the source heading but visually indistinguishable from body text. Confirmed directly on 3 domains. |
| Blockquotes | 16 | **Never** get a `>` prefix. Become plain paragraphs; the only surviving cue is the source's own quotation marks, when the source used curly quotes around the quoted speech. |
| Lists (as groups) | 16 lists / 79 items | Each list is folded into **one** paragraph unit with `-   ` bullets in `display` (even when the source was `
        ` — the ordinal is lost in favor of a flat dash). One exception observed (itm_29512ea6's numbered section list) split into per-item units instead. |
| List items, spoken | 79 items | `spoken` strips the bullet markers but does **not** insert a separator between items: at least 3 confirmed cases run items together with zero whitespace between the last word of one item and the first of the next (a mid-word, no-space run-on read aloud). This is the single clearest, most repeatable defect in the sample. |
| Code blocks | 12 (only itm_ecda776e) | 12/12 survive as distinct `code` units, verbatim. Best-preserved element type observed. |
| Tables | 0 in this sample | No table appeared in any of the 8 originals; no evidence either way. |
| Images | 18 | 13 kept; every confirmed drop (1, on itm_407e8fa6) has a matching `degradations` row with a concrete reason (`too small`), i.e. an intentional filter, not silent loss. Two other drops (itm_29512ea6, itm_5e723272) were not traced to a degradation row in this pass. |
| Links | 116 (HTML, includes some boilerplate) | 65 markdown links kept; spot-checked gaps (cutlefish, jamesshore) are bylines/nav/CTA links correctly excluded, not article-body links lost. |
| Emphasis (bold/italic) | 161 `///` tags | 62 `**bold**` markers counted (italic underscores not separately tallied in this pass); spot checks show markdown syntax is stripped correctly in `spoken` with no leaked `*`/`_` characters. |

## What this means for "markdown and lists"

The extraction pipeline has exactly three unit kinds (`paragraph`/`code`/`image` — see
`api/app/schemas/items.py`); there is no heading or blockquote or list-item kind. Headings
and blockquotes ride entirely on `paragraph` with no markdown syntax added, so a reading
surface that renders `display` as markdown shows every heading and every quote as an
undifferentiated paragraph. Lists get bullet-dash markdown in `display` but are usually
one unit per whole list rather than one per item, and the `spoken` derivation for that
merged case does not reliably insert a word-boundary or pause between items — the
concrete, repeatable defect an ear (not a diff) would catch first.
